answer: Each new agent posts a 4,000 POA glacier bond that is returned only after 25 epochs of clean work. A relic ledger keeps the answer fingerprints of every banned account, so a reborn identity that reuses old phrasing is matched at signup. A whisper audit sends 3 random established graders a private recheck of any two accounts that answer within 5 seconds of each other; if they confirm the link, both bonds are burned. Running 40 fakes locks 160,000 POA, and each caught pair loses 8,000 POA, so extra identities cost more than they earn.
